chapter: New Orleans clubs and Sharky's band
title: Radio broadcasts and movie work with Tony Almerico
summary: Broadcast on WDSU atop the Hibernia Bank; filmed a street movie with Almerico's band members.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: When you all played in the Blue Room, was that at the time when the Blue Room was broadcast on the radio?
Well, did you go to the station, radio station, ever broadcast?

Oh, yes. We were, we went up to, on top of the Hibernia Bank to play in WDSU on Channel Six. We were in the first jazz band that ever played there. Look at Red Bowman. There's Raymond. There's Raymond when he was a young man.
Yeah. But, uh, did you make any movies when you were with Sharky, that you remember?
No, but I did with Tony Amarica. Mm-hmm. Some street thing that they, they did, you know. Dave Winstein, Ellis Stratakis, Nick LaRocca, that's Jimmy's daddy.
Now, there's a trumpet player, Jimmy.
Leon Rapola. Charlie Cadela. Leo Addy. Joe Lycana. Uh, Freddie Lycana. He, he, yeah. Uh, um, Marco, Mickey Marco.
